note: Micon submodule: provides the `micon_link` widget (extends core LinkWidget) and `micon_link` formatter (extends core LinkFormatter) for the core `link` field type. Widget adds a #type micon picker; icon is stored on the link value at options.attributes.data-icon (position at data-icon-position). Widget settings: packages, icon (default), position (bool), target (bool). No settings form/configure route - configured on Manage form display / Manage display. Medium sets a link field's form-display widget to micon_link with a default icon; hard switches a link field's widget to micon_link. Both grounded in the core.entity_form_display component type.

evals.prompt: Using micon_link, what widget and formatter should I select for a core Link field to let editors attach an icon, and where do I select them?
evals.expected_output: Select the 'Link (with icon)' widget (id micon_link) on Manage form display and the 'Link (with icon)' formatter (id micon_link) on Manage display of the link field. Both are for the core `link` field type.

evals.prompt: When an editor picks an icon on a micon_link link widget, where is that icon actually stored on the field value?
evals.expected_output: On the link item's options: options.attributes.data-icon (and options.attributes.data-icon-position for before/after/icon_only).

evals.prompt: What settings does the micon_link widget expose besides the icon picker?
evals.expected_output: packages (which packages to offer), icon (a default/fallback icon), position (allow before/after/icon-only selection), and target (allow an open-in-new-window checkbox).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_micon_link_med configured to use the Micon link widget with a default fallback icon. Inspect the live default form display and report (a) the widget id and (b) the default icon configured on it.
evals.expected_output: The widget is micon_link and its settings.icon (default icon) is fa-star, in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default component field_micon_link_med.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_micon_link_task that currently uses the plain core link widget on its default form display. Using micon_link, switch that field's form-display widget to the Micon link widget (micon_link) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_micon_link_task component has widget type micon_link.
